thread:
IncidentBot: Incident created: HIGH error rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Severity: Sev2. Affected customers: multiple mid-market accounts. Rule matched: 5xx spike > 15% in 5m. Pager: @oncall.
Maria Chen: paging oncall, taking initial triage. seeing 5xx mainly from model shard allocation failure. rolling retries are exacerbating load.
Dan Park: oncall here, joining. thanks Maria — can you drop last 10m logs and sample trace ids?
Maria Chen: pasted traces and scrubbed logs in thread (see below). looks like gRPC stream failures during model streaming path.
Ralph Ng: quickly: is there a fallback config? can we route to smaller replica (quantized) to reduce memory?
Dan Park: temp mitigation plan: 1) disable streaming for long requests (force chunk size 256) 2) route requests > 2k tokens to fallback model pool 3) scale up dedicated workers in us-west-2 by +2 nodes. executing now.
Jess Ortiz: pinging support — prepping a customer note. ask: who needs immediate outreach vs status page only?
Support - L2: two customers reported during incident window with visible 500s, others saw latency. recommending targeted outreach to accounts A and B.
Ash Patel (PM): need a status page update ASAP. draft below.
Maria Chen: status page draft (please copy/paste):
```
Status: Investigating & Mitigating (us-west-2)
Impact: Some requests to the text-generation API may receive 5xx errors or elevated latency. We are routing traffic to fallback model pools and scaling capacity. Engineers are investigating root cause.
ETA: Reduced errors expected within 30–45 minutes as rolling mitigations complete. We will follow up with a post-incident summary.
```
Dan Park: applied routing and scaled +2 workers. error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% in 12m. continuing monitoring.
IncidentBot: Pager update: oncall acknowledged at 2106543245.
Maria Chen: assessment needed for SLA eligibility — collecting raw error counts, per-customer failure rates, and request volumes in the 1h incident window.
Kevin Liu: billing: can you prep rough credit calc if we meet SLA threshold? formula we use: credit = min(1.0, downtime_minutes / monthly_sla_minutes) * monthly_commit * credit_ratio. but need per-customer usage slice.
BillingBot: Requested usage slice export queued. ETA ~10m.
Ralph Ng: suggestion: offer affected customers proactive 5% onboarding credit while we finish RCA, then adjust if full SLA credit qualifies. keeps goodwill.
Jess Ortiz: drafting targeted email for Accounts A/B (short):
```
Subject: Brief outage notice — Redwood text-generation API (us-west-2)
Hi <Customer>,
We experienced elevated errors impacting some generate requests between 16:04–16:46 UTC. Our team mitigated the issue and reduced errors; you may have seen 5xx responses. We are investigating root cause and will follow up with a summary and any eligible account credits. Please reply if you saw production impact.
Regards, Jess (Support)
```
Ash Patel (PM): thumbs up on the draft. add a line offering a proactive 5% credit while RTP (Ralph's idea) is reviewed.
Kevin Liu: billing: prepping estimate based on exported slice. if we offer 5% now, I need the committed monthly number for each account.
Jess Ortiz: @Kevin I'll DM the account commits.
Dan Park: final check: error rates back to baseline (1.2%). keeping monitoring window 60m. will collect post-incident data for SLA calc.
Maria Chen: post-incident action items: 1) RCA doc (eng-runtime) 2) customer communication + list 3) billing estimate + tentative credit 4) rollout rule to avoid streaming allocation bump 5) follow-up postmortem.
Kevin Liu: billing will produce a draft credit sheet and recommended credit amounts within 24h.
Jess Ortiz: sending targeted emails to Accounts A/B now and posting the status page update.
Ash Patel (PM): agree to offer a proactive 5% credit for impacted accounts immediately; final SLA credit pending data review. I'll cc legal for wording.
Dan Park: handing off to next oncall at 2106543280 — @oncall-night please watch the alerting. thanks all. :wave: 
IncidentBot: Incident resolved (mitigation in place). Postmortem scheduled.
